text:
Hidden gem in Treasure Island! The happy hour is fantastic, huge cocktail menu and every drink on it is five dollars until 6pm.

I was so relieved to find a proper raw bar in this area. My wife and I enjoyed $1 oysters and the U8 shrimp cocktail and a few of the $5 happy hour apps.

I can't recommend this place highly enough for seafood lovers.

Good coffee and good baked items but seriously overpriced. Paid $35 for a pie-shaped coffee cake that was dry and bland. I informed management and they bought me a coffee...joke. Pecan pie was delicious, but for $35 it should have included the baker. Stopped in again today...$6 for an avg sized croissant!  Whole Foods sells four take home and bake chocolate croissants for $6! Heck, Trader Joes have amazing take home and bake croissants for $3.99! Watch what you order here before it costs you $30 for a lunch

Yeah I'm on vacation back in my hometown on Tucson, and came here with my family of 8 people and it was one of the worst meals I've had in a while. Stale chips (we know this because we told our server and they insisted they were fresh, but then the next round was warm and not stale, like they were just tryna get rid of old product), margaritas that tasted like they were from a box, rude wait staff (so many glares and server blamed my mom for her messed up dish), overpriced food. my steak was over cooked and bland. They even asked how I liked my steak cooked, I say med rare, and they send out a well done carne asada. You shouldn't have to cut into that thin steak to know it's over cooked. Bad cook there. I've never written two bad reviews for a place in one night, but just gotta make it be known that the owners of Guadalajara's obviously don't care about their customers, they only care in making as much money as they can. I can understand that a place gets busy and can slow down service - But they just forgot about us. I asked for water and no one returned, all 8 of us had empty water glasses through most of our meal... Find better Mexican food somewhere else

Went with two other couples for Mothers Day dinner. We were seated at our reservation time and drink orders were taken right away.
The food was very good and ample. Our server, Jessica, made the whole night enjoyable because she was attentive, professional and very nice to deal with.

I have never been a PF Chang's fan but this experience changed my mind and we will go back.
GREAT customer service and even better sandwiches! Love the environment and Will was dope. Definitely will be bringing my family back!!!!!

Bareburger continues to be delicious, every single time!  The vegans and vegetarians love it, as do those who appreciate organic, grass-fed meat.  Superb menu, from the burgers to the shakes to the sides!

This Turkish restaurant is a hidden gem in South Tampa. Food is delicious and abundant. We had the mix grill, which is tasty and generous, the Baked Hummus and lentil soup. Service was great as well. Very recommended!

It is definitely one of my favorite restaurants in NOLA. Very well mixed southern and general america style food and literally I want to try everything on the menu. Highly recommend the grilled oyster and smoke pork ribs. The other table ordered the pork chop and it was AMAZING!

They didn't make my pick up order until I got there. I asked for a refund because I didn't have the time to wait. They didn't apologize or try to rectify it until I asked for the refund. They just stood there talking amongst each other. Waste of time. Avoid this location unless you like dealing with incompetent people.
One of my favorite restaurants in Philly! The happy hour and lunch deals are surprisingly very reasonable and so so tasty!
We thought the menu was somewhat limited.  The food was ok, nothing special.  The desserts were good.  Kids love the macaroons.  Outdoor seating was spacious.  Service was average, a little slow.

We ordered 2 Rick James spicy chicken sandwiches to-go. They had set aside 25 sandwiches for service industry as well, which is amazing of them to do in this time. They are easily one of my favorite chicken sandwiches in New Orleans! The chicken thigh had just the right level of spice and heat, and the pickles and slaw added a great crunch. 

Southerns has been popping up at Lots-a-Luck Tavern in Lakeview for COVID-19, but they are normally often found at Urban South and Miel Brewery! Make sure to order early, since they often sell out quick.

The food looks Mediterranean but lacks the real taste. Beef Kabob didn't taste like Mediterranean food at all but just basic salt and pepper seasoning. Chicken kabob was too salty and dry. The lamb kabob was bland. Baklava was too sweet and dry and tasted as if it's been in the fridge a few days.. not fresh at all. I wonder if people who love coming here have actually tried other Mediterranean food outside of Idaho because this place isn't that great. It's really hard to find good ethnic dishes here in Boise.

Great Mexican spot with dine in seating during COVID-19. They close at 8:00 but it's nice to find indoor seating especially on the road with kids. The place is within walking distance from the casinos in downtown Reno. I definitely recommend the super burritos and the Quesadillas. I look forward to trying more items next time yum!

Had breakfast...The food was OK. Buffet set up which I am not a big fan of. Biscuits were a 3 on scale of 5. Gravy the same fairly bland ( could have used more sausage in it).   Very clean and bright facility.

Food was good, service was WAY below average. Our server Chase was too busy socializing 10 feet away from us the whole time with his co-workers to pay any attention to us. The restaurant wasn't even busy so it was very disappointing.

Aether is amazing! Food was so good ! Seafood was fresh ! I went for happy hour with my girls . I got oyster and mussel . Oysters was so juicy and delicious! The cocktail sauce was amazingly good . It taste like it was homemade! And the mussel was super good ! Very flavorful. If you ever in Fishtown you gotta stop by ! And they also have good cocktail drink too ! That a plus !

I've been a Downingtonian my whole life and this place was a fantastic addition to the local business scene. There's plenty of space inside, great decor, fabulous baristas, and a reasonable menu with fair prices considering quality of coffee. The best part is their quiet work room complete with a workspace and printer for those who need to get some work done outside of the house. Perfect date, meeting, and writing spot for me! Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a new hangout in the area. They also recently added a creamery next door which is, yes, way overpriced, but delicious and fun.

Love everything about this place but this is about a recent catering experience. Fried chicken that was absolutely delicious with two sides of your choice. Sides were outstanding, all foods were well packaged and tasted amazing the entire day and into the evening. Oh yeah, the chocolate chocolate chocolate cake for the birthday girl umm unbelievable.

I have ordered take out multiple times in the past month, and I am kept waiting 15-20 minutes past my expected pickup time that is given on the website every visit. I love the food, it's fresh and healthy, but have better uses of my time than standing around waiting longer than the amount I was given an expectation around. Even now as I write this, I'm listening to the lady next to me say they put someone else's order in her pickup bag. 

TLDR; This location really needs to figure out their online pick up.

We shared a bit of most everything, all of it was very good. Biggest hits, Bufflo smoked wings, I could have had the whole pound. Rib tips, very decadent. Pulled pork was juicy, would have loved a GF bun a sandwich would have been great! 

Good beer and a couple of good wines. Would come back when in STL.

I find it hard to believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. 
I'm not privy to all the ins and outs of Indian food. 
I love this place. 

The bathroom signs have Braille on them but it's just a printed piece of paper that has been laminated. 

I know a guy that stayed there for five weeks. He said it was great and tasted just like real Indian food.

Let me preface this by saying that I am from the south and have had great Cajun and creole food in NOLA, Savannah, FL, and MS.  We moved here 3 years ago and have not yet found a place for a good simple po' boy, étouffée, and jambalaya.  Cajun Kate's came recommended to us so we were excited to drive to DE to give it a try on a recent outing. Unfortunately we were quite disappointed.  The people were very friendly and we really wanted to like the place, even though it was a 30 min drive. They gave us small samples of the jambalaya and the creamy tomato Parmesan soup.  The soup was very good, but the jambalaya was cold and fairly bland.  We ordered one shrimp po' boy and one crawfish po' boy. Both were over breaded and over dressed with condiments.  The crawfish were practically unrecognizable as such.  Sorry, but it just didn't meet our high expectations.  I'm guessing that folks around here don't have other things to compare it to, so their reviews are generally good.  We wish you luck in your business, but it just wasn't our cup of tea.

At first, we were a little skeptical about going since the pictures were eh... but the food was actually delicious! Customer service was awesome! I had to switch my beer because the one my husband got me was not good so I switched it with out a fuss and the bartender was very helpful as well. Will definitely be coming down here again!
Love this place. Food is unbelievable!!!! Great prices. I always get the curried goat "mini" (so much food!!) and it's delicious. Comes with 2 sides too. A must go to on south street!
Made a reservation.    Perfect timing.  Staff was mostly attentive and friendly.   The food was delicious.   The bread too.   What a fun place.

The Crossing has been on my list for some time, I was really glad to see that it lived up to my high expectations!

The waitstaff was very respectful of public health and everyone wore a mask (there's a lot of places that don't follow this rule). Our server knew the menu inside and out and gave us great recommendations. She was a lot of fun!

I started with the beet salad. The presentation was beautiful. All of the flavors went together perfectly.

My entree was the Spanish Octopus appetizer. This was the best octopus I've ever had. The texture was not chewy and had a nice crisp outside. I loved the sauce and peas that paired so perfectly.

For dessert I had the peach cobbler. They say it's meant to share.. but it was too good to let that happen!

I'll definitely be back! Highly recommend.

Had Sugarfire for the first time this evening & was not disappointed! I had the turkey & brisket with baked beans & cornbread & really enjoyed all of it. Just when I thought it couldn't get any better, we also had their chocolate chip cookie. OMG, so good. Will definitely be going back. By the way, we did takeout & the portions were very generous. I'm happy to say I have leftovers!! Yummy!!

We were referred to eat here by friends and other Italians. We sat down at a table for two. Waited for ten minutes as waiters and waitresses passed us by and never even acknowledged we were there. So we went somewhere else. I would recommend you look elsewhere to eat.
This place is the best.     Their rolls may not be truly authentic but they're delicious.      Service  is friendly and they go out of their way for you.

From fruit cups, salads, sandwiches, pizza, soup, bread, bakery good, gelato,coffee,........AMAZING PLACE
The Reuben, the bakery desserts and the gelato are my favorite!!

Visiting Philly from Orlando, FL. This is a great concept that I wish we had back home. The pasta, and sauce were so fresh! I tried the gnocchi, and my boyfriend had the lasagna. Both dishes met our expectations. We got the regular sizes, and was the perfect amount for a quick lunch. I also read another review about the hot pepper olive oil, and that stuff packs a good punch! If we lived here, this would definitely become a regular spot.

Don't order delivery! We ordered delivery from their website. Around the time we were expected to receive our food, we received a phone call saying it was ready to pick up. After we explained that we in fact had ordered delivery, we were told they had no one available to deliver our food so we had to pick it up. We received an apology, but no offer of a discount or compensation.

When I went to pick the food up, I was greeted by someone who was only halfway wearing a face mask (nose out) who didn't bother to keep 6 feet away from me. Other staff were improperly wearing masks in the same way. Our food was not back in the kitchen, but sitting on a table in the middle of the dining room where tons of maskless patrons were eating. The main reason we had ordered delivery in the first place was to avoid having to make contact with potential Covid carriers, so it was upsetting to see so many protocols being violated.

Bottom line: (1) If you can't deliver, don't let people order delivery! At a minimum, call us *before* preparing our food and charging us. (2) Coronavirus kills, stop endangering your customers and wear your masks properly.

Cosmos has been around forever. I've lived in DE for over 35 years, and I tried it out for the first time this past month. It's not in the best area of Wilmington, but I've passed by in dozens of times.

With a name like Cosmos, you'd expect it to have plenty of Greek offerings. They do, and they have just about everything else you'd expect for a diner-style restaurant. It takes you some time to navigate through the menu, so take a full look before ordering.

There is a kids' menu and reasonably priced platters. My gyro was very good. My son' got a kids' pasta meal. The sauce, which we asked for on the side, had a hint of cinnamon, which was off-putting for my son. Wife's chicken salad was very large and is ideal for sharing.

Limited parking next to the restaurant, but a nice sized lot across a small cross street. During Covid, we checked in and returned to our car until a table was ready for us; at which time, they called us to let us know that we were ready to be seated.

Arrived to get my pickup order and was told it wasn't quite ready yet, no problem. But then I was asked to wait outside. In November. While they had empty chairs in the front of the restaurant. 
Surprised by the poor customer service. If they don't want people waiting inside for orders, don't put out chairs. Seems like common sense.

My 4 friends and I ate dinner around 8 pm on a Saturday night. We had about a 15 min wait. Once seated, we were in a booth directly beside the kitchen. Our waiter was precious. His name was Trofim. (Trophy with an m)He was happy to tell us the origin of his name and his story of adoption. 

Between us we ordered the spinach and artichoke dip with lavish crackers, seared ahi tuna salad, the bedda chedda burger, the chicken sandwich with cheese and asparagus and the salmon with riced cauliflower. The food was all good. The highlight was the dip and the chocolate cake we split for dessert. The dip had huge chunks of artichokes and the cake had a delicious whiskey butter sauce. My friend raved over the ahi salad. The rest of us enjoyed ours but would probably try something different next time.

Started taking up on eating healthier and more of a plant based diet but was unaware of where to go or what type of restaurants would serve something "good tasting". When I thought of plant dieting I was already iffy about it all! Glad I found this place everything I've ordered from the coli bites to the burgers is excellent! A great substitution and alternative for meat eaters like myself in the past! Order the B-9 it's my favorite

Love sky cafe.  A favorite, and just ordered during covid, it was packaged so beautifully ( in a banana leaf!) and easy to transfer, so fresh.  Fast delivery.  Great service.  This really feels like the best hidden secret in philly and for such a low price.

Was the only person waiting in line. After 15 minutes of silence, another customer shows up, walks to the pick up section of the counter, and orders his coffee before me. I decided to not buy anything. These reviews say this place is a hit or miss which is only partially true. Saying it is a hit or miss gives you a 50/50. The miss is around 75 to 80 percent of the time while 20 to 25 percent of the time it is a hit. Customer service 
barely exists. No wonder this Dunkin is infamously known as the WORST Dunkin in the area. Better off going to Wawa right down the road.
Akeem is a great server. We had a terrible experience last week at Fairview heights Cracker Barrel. We tried this location instead and he definitely made up for it! Very prompt and on top of things.

We stopped by because we saw the reviews and were excited to try it. Luckily, it was happy hour when we got there and were able to choose where we wanted to sit outdoors. The staff was nice. We ordered the sopecitos yucatecos, tostadita de ceviche verde, and taco culichi, for drinks modelo especial, spicy cucumber margarita and Paloma clásica. The food was good, different from what I've had before. What I did not enjoy were the mixed drinks. I asked the waiter if I could switch my spicy cucumber margarita for the Paloma clásica because I didn't like, but was shocked that the Paloma clásica wasn't good either. They both tasted bland. Difficult to explain how they were missing flavor.

I had a taste for BBQ and have seen Sugarfire BBQ locations in St Louis, so when this location opened in O Fallon Illinois I decided to try it.  I visited Sugarfire during Illinois band on indoor dining during the pandemic, so I had to take my order to-go.  I ordered quite a few items to get a taste of the broad menu, I ordered ribs, brisket, sausage, and for sides I ordered beans, coleslaw, and a potato hash with rib meat (I can't remember the exact name).  The meats were all delicious and tender, but the brisket was definitely the star of my order.  The sides were good, except the coleslaw was lacking flavor.  The beans were unique but good, and the potato hash with rib meat was out of this world.  Sugarfire has a wide array of sauces and sodas.  I highly recommend Sugarfire if you enjoy good BBQ.

Just got take out from here this past Saturday. What a great Indian food experience! Not sure how I didn't find it earlier. 

Very easy ordering experience over the phone (although the website and mobile ordering app had slightly different menus). Food was ready in about 20 min and packed very nicely. Had the goat curry which came with the bone and was delicious! Good amount of gravy, and the spices had really gotten into the goat. Got a good helping of rice as well. It was rice...not much else to say. Ordered one garlic na'an which was good and not too greasy. Also had the samosa chaat as an appetizer. Great mix of flavors and a generous helping of it (enough for two people to split). Finally had the masala dosai with spinach. Unfortunately they had to kind of smush it into the container so it was a bit discombobulated when we got it home. Crispy and flavorful. Came with coconut chutney which was excellent and some sambar which was good as well. Also ordered kulfi and I totally forgot it was ice cream. Might be nice if their online menu had some descriptions of the food items so that people not familiar with Indian food or who have forgotten can learn what they're ordering. 

Overall delicious food, good helpings but not excessive. Didn't seem too oily/doused in cream which is a problem with Indian food from restaurants a lot. And the price wasn't bad at all! Unexpected, but actually one of my favorite Indian food experiences in Philly!
My favorite Italian quick serve place. I love the different types of food you can order and its reasonably priced.
Fantastic place, Dillion the bartender is amazing. Everyone has been so wonderful. Onion rings yummy!

This place is so solid!! Our son plays hockey and we eat here almost every week. The buffalo bites are awesome, the pizza is fresh and the coffee is 5 stars!! We love this place. The remodel looks great.
Wine and food is amazing! Our server, Nikolos W was amazing with recommendations and overall vibes. I highly suggest you ask for him as your server because it made our experience ten times better!

I LOVE this place. The show they put on, the food, the atmosphere. It's all just amazing. Took my boyfriend and he loved it as well. Ill start off by saying the fried rice is the BEST. I believe it was an additional 3.75 to upgrade to it but definitely worth it. I also got the noodle upgrade this time which is 8 dollars but I was given practically a whole plate of noodles. Boyfriend has the Kobe beef and lobster (pretty pricey) but he said it was definitely worth it. I had a piece of it and it was very yummy. I got the teriyaki chicken and filet mignon. Very yummy as well!! We also had cocktais; I had the peach mojito. Omg YUM! At the end of our meal our chef sang a song and it was the cutest thing ever. He was very entertaining and attentive the whole time. 
We don't come here very often but every chance I have to come, I take!!

Cute eclectic breakfast place!  And definitely worth any wait. I really appreciated the unique menu. Lots of benedict options that were really well thought out.  Breakfast is my favorite meal and I could eat breakfast all day long and I loved Sweet Sage.  The staff was excellent and super accommodating making suggestions for my youngest. The portions were the perfect size. And the food came so fast! Good coffee too...I'm super picky about coffee but it was full-bodied and not bitter. 
The décor was fun, lots of signs with funny sayings to entertain you while you wait for the food (which again, was incredibly fast.) 
Thank you! Hope to come again.
The nicest people always.  The food is always good and cooked to order.  If you are a regular, they know your staple order but will always make a taste suggestion.

If I could give zero stars I would. Ordered delivery for my family. Five minutes AFTER scheduled delivery time, I got a one line email saying the delivery was canceled. No call, no explanation. Ridiculous.

Only been here once so far- but yum! This is not a Los Betos (the name!) and it isn't 24 hours, but it sure makes up for it in great prices and menu variety. I was pleasantly surprised by the low prices for delicious menu items from burros to taco salads. I settled on a ham plate to go. It consisted of eggs and ham deliciously scrambled together, as well as a generous side of beans and rice. They packed in a huge tortilla and some salsa, and I also could grab some more salsas (hmmmm hot!) and some peppers and carrots and onions to toss on. I ate half and had plenty left in the morning to share for breakfast. Friendly and very fast service, too!

If you want fine dining in Tampa, PLEASE skip Bern's and come here. We nor our guests have been disappointed. This week we indulged for our anniversary dinner that hit almost all the right notes. This is also where we had our rehearsal dinner more than a decade ago. The food was wonderful like it was then. The scallop appetizer was particularly well balanced. The warm olive oil cake is something to return for. My spouse enjoyed the espresso ice cream. However, our waiter was perfectly fine for standard diner service, not for a fine dining establishment at this price point. I tipped the guy 20%+ so as not to perpetuate the terrible stereotype of poor women tippers. However, he was generally non attentive to our table, and we're not hard to please. For example, the hot tea arrived after dessert was consumed. There were other indications that he was just not paying attention to us, either in the ways a good wait staff does without being told, or in specific requests like please only bring us one scoop of ice cream. We got three. What a waste. It also took quite a while to remove food from the table after our courses were clearly done. I'm not going to allow one poor waiter to ruin my enjoyment. However, if we are assigned to one of this server's tables, I will ask to be moved.

I'll start by saying they have a very reasonable happy hour, which was the reason for our visit this afternoon. We walked into the bar area and were hit with a very unpleasant odor. We sat at the bar and ordered our drinks, a margarita and a beer. The margaritas are not made to order, rather a pre-made mixture which is disappointing. We ordered our food, and while we were waiting for our food I watched in disbelief a mouse run from the dining area to behind the bar. While I am sure there are many places I dine on a regular basis that have mice here and there, I have never seen one so close to me. The bartender came out with our food and I informed her and she responded with "I will let the managers know" followed by another comment that led me to believe this is a common problem and not the first complaint. She went to the back and came back out to let us know she had reported it. No manager ever came out to apologize. My boyfriend and I were disgusted so we ate a few bites of our meals and wanted to leave. She was apologetic and probably embarrassed and it's not her fault. Having worked in the business, We should have been approached by a higher up. We then began to look around at all the other visible dirt and grime surrounding the bar, including flies and dust. We've been here several times before where they leave chips and salsa sitting behind the bar.. imagine the flies landing on them.. or the mouse that may have ran across that surface prior to their opening of the res

Wow, from the moment we walked in, until the time we left, our experience was perfection. We were welcomed in like family, and although this restaurant is truly elegant, the atmosphere is relaxed. The menu is beautiful with a variety of options. We ordered the Etch salads, the Lamb, and the Tempura Tofu. Each course was outstanding. If you are gluten free, they will accommodate you and ensure you have a fabulous meal! 
The service could not have been any better. It was our first visit, but not our last!!!!

The Salvadorena is impossible to describe - it is the most heavenly, delicious NON CHOCOLATE thing I've ever tasted!!! The Monsoon Cookie is another impossible to describe (this with chocolate) sensational cookie. The chocolate bars are each superb.

This is just a wonderful shop.

I am legitimately mad this place isn't closer to my house and that it took me so long to try it! The service is amazing, the food amazing, tea is amazing and the coffee is SO FLIPPIN GOOD!! I had their Cubano Breve and it is now my favorite drink in town. It is seriously perfect. The story of why they decided to pick Pangolin also captured my attention and made me love this place even more. Ask them about it next time you're in  


Also I have to add that as a marketing person their branding is gorgeous and totally on point.

Update: Dear God their Pangolin Waffle is amazing!  It is like my hopes and dreams in waffle form.  If I could give this place a billion stars I would.  Everything tastes so good and the people are amazing!

sometimes this mcdonald's can be a little dodgy, but the girl tonight with the caramel pixie cut really hooked it up. she delivered the customer service that we needed at 5am before a long day. she valued her customers and really delivered the kind of service that you rarely see at a mcdonald's these days. cherish her, and honestly give her a raise if possible.

First time trying this place.  I have driven past here many times and have wanted to stop in.  Apparently they raise their own chickens and that's where all the eggs come from.  We ordered a chocolate croissant, wet hen Benedict and quiche Lorraine. The quiche crust was so flakey and florable.  The ham was nice and mellow on the Benedict and didn't over power it. The potatoes were crispy and will seasoned.  The coffee is made by Blind Dog coffee and wonderful local company.

I've been to DeSanos multiple times but I've usually kept my pizza pretty simple. Tonight a friend and I split the carnivale pizza which has stuffed ricotta crust and sausage on the pizza and it was fantastic. The calzones look amazing too-- hope to try one soon. There is a small parking lot outside with free parking!
Loved our brunch here! Nicole our server was amazing. We had a group of 8 - the food was terrific and Nicole's upbeat spirit helped turn our meal into a party! Will be back!

I went there to meet a friend for lunch, nice place and crowded. As it is running well, the did not provide any specials for lunch so just the regular menu which was a little pricey for this area. For example you need to pay 3$ for fries that should be included with the sandwiches and and extra order is 7-8$! Other than that it is a nice bar and good food and drink with a nice outdoor seating. Nothing to drive a longer distance too but not bad either. We had split the fried chicken smoke pork sandwich which both were good and filling.

Delicious food and very friendly staff. This place always makes our Friday night even better. Great business to support and the best margaritas in town! They also have great catering. Made our graduation party taco bar a big hit!

Today we went to mod pizza for lunch and ordered 2 minis. I though that the staff was nice and polite. Greeting everyone that walks through the door. I had the mini pizza with spicy tomato sauce and mozzarella. Next, I got the pepperoni with spicy sausages for my meats. For my toppings I got the pineapple, jalapeño, and salt and pepper. I always enjoy a simple pizza! Being on the side of town we always stop by for a quick lunch and it never lets us down. I don't think we will ever get tired of eating at mod pizza. The price for a mini or even a regular size mod pizza is very reasonable! I recommend trying this place out when you're on the side of town, plus there are stores like Nordstrom rack and Dick's sporting goods to walk around after the meal to digest the food.

I've been here a handful of times, either for brunch or for drinks and it's always a good time. The ambiance is great, the drinks are great, the food is good. The real winner here is the staff, though. They are always over the top helpful (in a good way!) and honestly just make the whole experience more fun. I don't know how they manage to have so many great people consistently but I love it. Those cute little corn biscuits are also a nice touch. Keep it up, JFH!
This is our favorite place for Pizza! The Prego is loaded and the crust is perfect! Get it without ground beef and ask for a side of the Cajun sauce to dip your crust in.

This place is awesome. Been here a half a dozen times and I've gotten a new thing each time and everything is great. The cheese curds awesome! The chicken sandwich awesome! The wedge salad awesome!!!! This is my favorite place to eat!!!

This is our go-to pizza place for St Louis style pizza. Ordering take-out is a breeze and is usually ready in only 10-15 minutes. The staff is always super friendly. We love the sweet tasting pizza sauce and the abundance of topping choices. Definitely recommend for any occasion!

This place is starting up so it still has some things to work out but the menu is super different and everything is very very fresh. The bartender was informative and made great suggestions. Service was friendly and there's plenty of parking (parallel parking or $4 for parking at a nearby lot). I would recommend this place for a date night or girls night out.
The ambiance, quality of food & drink options- all wonderful. A chill yet inviting environment. Fun & walkable area... great for tourists & locals alike!

love love love their food. take out would be wonderful. i hope they decide to do so if they haven't done so already. it would great for those that sometimes who rather eat at home. a lot of restaurants, big name ones have take out. get on board border's.

This place is soooooo good. On my first time here I tried the pastrami Reuben and onion rings. I don't know if I'll ever be able to order something different. It is delicious and I almost regret finding this place because now I think about the pastrami Reuben all the time. 10/10 stars

It was an average pasta place. It looks like a take out place because they ring you up at the cash register but then there's silverware on the table. They bring your order to you in a plastic container. I ordered the Cajun grilled chicken penne pasta. The chicken was pretty bland but the pasta was cooked well and the sauce was good. I would try other options.

We wanted to give a shout-out to all the people, working at the Jockamo's in Irvington, during March, April, and May! (Prior to that as well).  Thanks for the great service, and adapting to "Curbside"!  The food and service is always excellent, A+.  We love the pizza, salad, and sandwiches!  Great variety, helpful and friendly service.  Salad with seafood and balsamic, and the Greek salad, are fresh and a great sides to the versatile pizza choices!  Peace, Hope, Comfort, a couple of seniors, East Indy

3 1/2 stars, unbelievable. I don't know who you guys are a who give this place a bad rating but, Hamburgers are pretty much my favorite food. No question in my mind that juicy's giant hamburgers on Wells Street is the best place to get a hamburger in Northern Nevada Period. Ask for a rare hamburger here. They'll make that for you. Try there any of these other hamburger joints. Guaranteed not a one of them will take a burger temperature order. The meat quality and the preparation method Of these never frozen delicious juicy hamburgers is absolutely superb. Pretty much this place is perfect.

I saw the Dutch on TV News today January 1st, 2021, they were offering a Pop-Up Soul Restaurant as a daily special for thirty-five dollars $35.00. I saw the reporter Bill Anderson interview the chef and he said the event was just to raise money because of the impact of COVID-19 on the industry. I decided to purchase a meal for my sister who is in a nursing home and has not been able to see our family or have a holiday meal. I was so disappointed with the food I received. The chicken was dried out I had requested sides of collard greens and black-eyed peas. The portions looked like a kids meal. The total price with a mandatory tip and tax wax forty-four dollars and eighty cents. (44.80). What a disgraceful rip off. When the front desk personal delivered the meal. The nursing staff called to request for me to give them the phone number of the Dutch so they could complain. I just don't understand how people could just rip people off. You look at this photo and judge if you think it was worth forty-four dollars and with cents (44.80). Please help me by boycotting this place. This place deserves a zero.

Worst bar I've been to in a very long time. Witnessed two fights within five minutes of being here. The guy who stated he was the owner was very rude to every woman who he came into contact with, overheard him judging their clothing decisions and stating that they were not beautiful enough to be in his bar. 

Second, this business is not following any sort of COVID guideline. They also have random people who aren't employed or even affiliated with the business placing their hands on customers who aren't their friends, pushing them forcefully out of the doorway, telling them to put masks on. However, when the customers are someone that they are friends with or acquainted with, they don't bother telling them anything about a mask. 

The bartenders are absolutely horrendous, it takes at least fifteen minutes to get any sort of service, and when you do get service from one of the bartenders, it's subpar and they are extremely rude and act as if you are a burden.

Definitely will not support this business, nor will we ever return to such an egregious establishment. This place should be permanently shut down.
I ordered the new spicy nuggets. Waited for 10 mins and they only give me 9 pieces. Whoever did it cant count well.

I absolutely love this place. Visited Tampa with my boyfriend and we had to check this place out. Its all outdoors. There are food vendors in shipping containers. Theres about 8 or so different options. There's a bar for alcoholic beverages. We ordered oysters from the boat run oyster company. And a Thai chicken noodle from another stand. There was a live band. We were able to sit under a covered area. It was super hot that day. They seem to be pet friendly. It's a great place to lounge and hang out.

Great spot to stop for lunch, dinner or just a drink with friends.  We've been twice now and tried the burgers, chicken bites and wraps and all were delicious!  The service is always great too.  We'll definitely be back.

I didn't think this place would wow me much. It sounded like another wannabe Asian restaurant that served overly Americanized dishes. It goes to say that what sounds or looks like may not actually be, and to make a true judgement you have to be willing to take the risk and try the place out yourself. Well, I'm happy I gave Ling & Louie's a shot.

First off you have to remember you're not going to find any true Asian dishes here, but American-Asian food, which means it's based off old Asian recipes but twisted into something that will delight the American's palate. Typically what that means is dumping loads of sodium into the recipes. Ling & Louie's, however, does a fantastic job incorporating other flavors to enhance the taste of their dishes. For example, I ordered the Drunken Stir Fry dinner with chicken, which was loaded with some many different ingredients. Pineapples, onions, red bell pepper, and broccoli piled one top of white rice. The pineapple flavoring dominates the dish, more so than the tropical sauce that comes served flaming. While this was as far from any traditional Asian dish as you can get, it tasted fantastic. I appreciated the hefty portions of vegetables and chicken. All ingredients mixed perfectly well together and the sauce just topped it all off for me. Well, and the pineapple. 

After scanning their sushi menu quite precariously I ordered the Vegas roll. It consists of spicy tuna, eel, cream cheese, jalapeno, tobiko, tempura fried, and spicy mayo. As

We were excited about this place but the service seemed a bit chaotic. We were forgotten about in the beginning as we were told we could wait outside to be seated so we sat near the outdoor heaters at a dirty table. The table was cleared but never wiped down and our names never called.

After we were done eating and plates cleared we sat outside for a good 15 minutes for our check.

Went inside to ask and pay and it took three people to figure out that our ticket wasn't in the system or even an Im sorry for the inconvenience.

Ive worked in retail and food industry for over a decade and am aware of errors happening but this seemed unprofessional and unempathetic towards your customers who's first time it was visiting. Not a great first impression for me. I also do not want to be called "sis" or "babe" from my waitress. Very cringy.

My pancakes were amazing though and so was my mimosa so Id give that 5 stars for sure!

I hope the service can be a bit more professional and more of an I care about my customers time and service attitude.

The view was good (and similar to one I had just seen from a hospital room), the food was good (restaurant week portions) but be careful with the service....the reservation requires a deposit which is kinda unusual but the worse part was our waiter decided to double his tip.  We had a gift card and told him to give himself a $40 tip but he decided to process it as $80 and then we were given the balance on our gift card.  Had the balance on our GC not be checked by me, he would have made $80. Luckily we caught it and now have a major sour taste for this place.  Someone fixed it for us but the waiter never can back to apologize sohis tail must have been caught between his legs.  Buyer beware.

Clean! Clean! Clean! Anytime you are getting raw fish from a place, you hope to walk in and feel cleanliness. This place is tighty and well put together to make you feel good about your food. The staff is overly helpful, with tons of delicious options to make your own custom Poké experience fun and enjoyable. There aren't many Poké spots around, but this is one of the nicer and cleaner of the options. This rating was made after my 5th visit so I was compelled to leave good remarks.

Used to love this place, but not so much anymore. Drinks and apps were good, but bartenders are not attentive and are not in any way friendly. Bad vibe from the employees. What happened to customer service?  I won't be back. These are problems that could be easily be fixed.

The restaurant features do it yourself hot pot with a choice of 5 broths and many add ins. We tried several broths, all good. Spicy means spicy. My favorite ingredients were udon noodles  , mushrooms, little Sausages, and some fresh lettuce and tomato. Ice cream was included for desert. Maybe not the most child friendly restaurant, as the hot pots are within easy reach. Nice date place though. Music was current, brightly lit interior, and plenty of belly room in the booths. The only thing I wished they had was bao(buns). The soup made me want bread to chew on. Staff was very helpful and friendly. A nice evening out.

A fast causal ramen shop with boba is perfection when you need a quick pick me up. They only accept credit card due to COVID and they have a couple of tables outside. Their tea is freshly brewed per order and is customizable to your liking. I usually get the roasted oolong with 75% sugar and it is super refreshing.
Walked in from the start they were very unorganized and rude they got my order wrong and took forever they weren't wearing gloves either very unsanitary!
Great seafood boil. Had a great shrimp, blue crab and sausage loved the butter garlic. Seemed to be full and popular

I honestly don't know why people like this place. It has the most over priced nonsense and I'm from Cali. I feel like this Irish gastropub is going through an identity crisis as it offers things like avocado toast next to chicken pot pie? Not quite sure what it is or what it's doing but "this ain't it chief"

Just some notes for the chef: a grilled cheese sandwich should at least have some grilled cheese. I did not buy a sautéed spinach and grilled onion sandwich. Why would I? That sounds horrible. Overcooked bacon and no cheese sauce on your fries that you have the audacity to charge 9 bucks for? I'd have been better off getting the pretentious avocado toast

There's waaaay too many options inside this market for mediocre overpriced food. I'd say pass this one.
Best sushi!!! Great service!! Can't wait to go back. If you go bye sure tio get the tempura banana ice cream...so unbelievable and good...ask for no sprinkles...it doesn't need them.yummy!!!

Not worthy of one star.  Ordered a burger and fries that took 35 minutes to deliver.  Food was cold and server tried to argue that "they just now gave it to me."  Also ordered a flatbread with no peppers, and it arrived with peppers.  Pitiful execution to below average food.

I found this place a couple months ago and it changed my life. Please eat here. It will fill a void in your life that you didn't even realize you had. Matter of fact, I know what I'm eating for dinner tonight

I have always been a fan of Seoul Taco since they've been a food truck. We ordered from the Delmar store during quarantine when we saw they were offering a family style taco meal. I got the beef bulgogi taco kit with extra corn shells and chips with queso. The price was really reasonable for the amount of food we got! As a family of three we were eating it for the whole weekend! The kimchi rice is really good and the sauce trio really makes it in my opinion. Can't wait to go back again!

Great tuna sashimi!!!

Wife and I stopped in for a cocktail and a bite to eat. The tuna blew us away. Great seaweed salad to go along with it.

My boyfriend and I had one of the best meals here yesterday!  We had escargot, pork chop, sea bass , and cherry jubilee. It's definitely an unforgettable meal. The food here is compatible ( probably better than some) with upscale restaurants in Philadelphia. This is such a great restaurant in this small town. Too bad we live too far away but will definitely return if we have another opportunity to pass by this area. The restaurant staff are very knowledgeable and attentive that makes it a perfect fine dining experience

Manager was not uniformed and drinking a beer in the back while the server was having a hell of a time figuring out a check with a free app voucher for 30+ minutes. Offered a pizza voucher and we turned it down hard. No thanks. My family won't be at this restaurant ever again.oh and he straight up threw his waitress under the bus claiming to her face that "oh well, she's not our best waitress" terrible manager terrible service and the kids waited for 10 minutes longer for a simple hot dog and some kraft Mac and cheese.

Came here for a sit-down lunch since I've missed dining in. There was ample outdoor seating when we arrived. It began to fill up around 12:30pm though. The tables outside are placed appropriately apart to follow social distancing guidelines. Very spacious!

All waiters were wearing masks and gloves. Everything was clean and sanitizer was available at the host stand at the entrance.

The food was excellent as always. Especially the Chile Relleno. I recommend any of the burritos and enchiladas. The House Margarita was not too sweet, just perfect.

Great service amidst this crisis.

l like it so much, roasted pepper and onions, what! never tryied that before, this definitely satisfies my curiousity. For the medium burro, it has chunks of meat, and nice flavored, absolutely will come back and eat here again.
As a native New Yorker, this is the place to get NYC style pizza in St. Louis. If you're a fan of Imos, don't bother coming here.

Always the best almond milk tea! It's like almond float with boba instead of fruit. The place gets really busy for food on weekends, but they have a separate line for milk tea. All I would ask is, could you open a bit earlier?

Not only the BEST pizza around, but the kindest and most generous owners.

WE ordered the wrong order & not only did they make us what we thought we ordered, but threw in a free cheesesteak. Who does that? It was our mistake.

They treat their customers like family. 

Customers for life
Great vibe! Friendly bar staff and great chips and 3 kinds of salsa that were all excellent! You know a good Mexican restaurant by how fresh the salsa and chips are! Perfect spot for a Weekend night.

With the reputation the restaurant had already established, I had expected a great meal but wasn't certain to what extent. They blew those expectations clear out of the water, as there wasn't one thing I could pick apart. Our waiter Travis was friendly and helpful over the course of our meal. His recommendation of the bregenwurst was knock it out of the park good. And don't skimp out on desert, as that was a fitting ending to what we enjoyed.
Worst chipotle location in the country. Extremely slow service. Food is never fresh.  Staff don't care

Zero consideration went into their service. We went here on New Year's Eve when they had shipping containers available to eat outside during COVID, and it took them an hour to finally bring us our food. The reservations were for 1 hour and 15 minutes, so we really only had 15 minutes to eat all of our food and drink our drinks. The waitress told us we needed to be more mindful how long we were staying, but who could cram all their food and drinks in a party of 6 in just 15 minutes? The space heater in the pod was on the ceiling so none of the heat could get down to the table, since heat rises, which wasn't a huge deal, and their Poke Fries are actually just potato chips which wasn't at all clear on the menu. That stuff is forgivable but trying to rush us out when we still have food in our mouths because it took YOU an hour to get our food out is your own fault. I'm glad you don't need my business to get by, because I'm never going back.

Great food and great service! Plenty of vegetarian options. Delicious sandwiches and the tomato pie is the best around. You can tell fresh quality ingredients are used - no short cuts taken in food preparation. Stocks pound cake and other goodies available.  You will not be disappointed.

Only reason I gave this establishment one star is because it required it. I'm 9 months pregnant with swollen feet unable to drive at the moment. I called for delivery and was perfectly fine with a two hour wait for delivery. Once my pizza arrived I noticed my order was incorrect. I immediately called to inform them. I spoke with a "manager" who was quickly RUDE. I let him know about the issue. I ordered one side pepperoni one side sausage. I got sausage over the entire pizza. He said eat one side & they'll reroute to send the other half. WHAT A JOKE. No apology or anything. I let my son eat his half & noticed that my order of wings had some boneless some bone in with only 7 when I ordered 8. I didn't feel the need to call back. I just won't spend my money at this specific imos. Very disappointed....

Simply put, delicious fresh food. An extensive menu of salads, sandwiches, appetizers and burgers. Including some vegan options. Tried the Hawaiian burger and let me tell you it's the burger like no other! I simply can't have enough of this place, the atmosphere is so peaceful and love the outdoor seating area or you can even take your food and eat it at the beach that is just steps away.

First time here and will be back!! Outdoor and indoor seating options. We were warmly greeted by Sierra who made some food suggestions. Jax was our amazing and friendly server. We ordered the brewburger quesadilla, wings garlic hot, sweet potato tots and the fried shrooms!!!! Holy yummo the food was tasty and service was even better. You won't be disappointed. Can't wait to come back. Thank you for a great experience

We have gotten Joe's a few times for lunches at work and will definitely continue to do so.   I have people asking me if we are getting it this week because they want the upside down Sicilian (SO GOOD).  This week we got pasta and some meats.  One employee said it was the best meatball he has ever had.  We also got hot fresh rolls with it!  Definitely recommend Joe's!

We are here while in town for a conference. My friend had the pot roast with potatoes and LOVED it, I had a bite and it is super good. My other friends had the seafood platter and ate all that was on their plate. I had the stuffed chicken maumau it was heavenly! The chicken comes on a bed of "field pea fricassee" which reminds this California girl of red beans, with a stewed tomato relish (which is stewed tomatoes with a spicy Italian seasoning flavor) and fried okra on top. The peas are good alone, but with a little of the tomato stuff it is an epic bite of deliciousness. The chicken with stuffing was well seasoned, flavorful, and juicy. It was the best bite I have had so far in New Orleans. The desert was not on the menu so I was pleasantly surprised when she offered it. We tried the white chocolate bread pudding and the peach crumble with pecans. The bread pudding warm is amazing, but once the ice cream chilled it down it got a bit dense and congealed. The peach crumble was absolutely delicious. The crumble is buttery and crispy and the peaches provide the sweet balance. The staff is also super friendly, my only negative was the wait time for the food. But if you are not on a time crunch you need to eat here.
Funky hours to check before you go/order. Little hole in the wall with the most amazing Burritos. Everything is really fresh and tasty. Big fan!

We found this little gem when a friend was visiting Indy for the Monumental marathon. After a celebratory dinner at Rick's we came over to the Foyt Wine Vault in Speedway, IN to share a couple bottles of vino. 

The ambiance is great, the wine is tasty (try the Meritage), and we were able to sit and chat comfortably. AJ Foyt racing history adorns the walls and there's even an Indy car in the room. The service was nice and we are looking forward to going back to try some of the small eats on their tasting menu.
My husband went here during COVID and was impressed with their cleaning and safety precautions!

This place is so delicious! A must for anyone in St Louis! I got the brisket dip and it was so good! The onions were perfectly cooked. The sweet lady who checked us out gave our twins free cookies which was just the most sweetest. You do have to sit wherever which is cool but may be hard for large groups. There was outside sitting area as well. All the drinks were from local companies. From the soda and beer. It was wonderful to be able to try local drinks with delicious bbq. Their sauces were delicious!

Pretty basic counter service Chinese restaurant in the CWE, but the food was not greasy at all and came in massive portions for very cheap. 3 different size options, I went with the dinner portion, and had plenty of leftovers. Meals come with a spring roll, soup, fried or steamed rice, and a crab rangoon, but you can also substitute any of those side items for each other. Food was prepared incredibly quickly ~2 min after ordering

Not a great food or service experience. 

This was on my list of pet friendly places to try in Brandon.  I situated my dog outside, cleaned my very dirty table and chair and went in for a menu. 

The host did ask me if I had been there before and i said no. He did tell me just to come in and when I was ready. I told him I had my dog outside and he said okay. 

I decided on tacos. It is what they are known for, and went inside. I wanted the Killer and Jimi Churri. We dont have cabbage I can put lettuce on it okay, not really. My back up was the Baja, nope also cabbage. 

So I ordered the Johhny Utah and Wipeout. And asked for water for my dog. He filled up a soda cup, I asked for a small bowl. He said he would look. If you pet friendly have clean bowls or other options and when someone has their pet, offer water. He found a little to go styrofoam pint and that worked. 

They brought the tacos to the table here ya go, see ya. I didn't have utensils, so I scrapped the black corner off of my avocado and the black on the bottom. I didnt know these were cold tacos. The combinations are not very good cold. The pork was a little chewy and cold mac & cheese, not a plus. There was way too much sauce on the wipeout and it left a peculiar after taste. 

There was only one other patron at a high top, a family finishing  up and a woman placing an order. There were 4 staff here and they could have been a little more on the ball. I hope the cabbage is in the truck that came and everything wa
Got the bacon cheese burger and it was delicious I recommend anyone to go there the burger was cooked just right with bacon crisp pickles  and bun was toasted fabulous
Great staff! Well thought out menu options, poor execution of the menu and tasteless very bland real shame we were so hopeful . Wont be back !

The wait time was long but they didn't have much tables so that's understandable. They check your temperature once you arrive to the restaurant and are ready to be seated. Service is very fast and the food was really good. I was really craving some spicy ramen and I'm glad we chose this place! It definitely was worth it !

Despite the other reviews on here, I thought I would give this a try. I am glad I did. The server (Ryan) was pleasant, prompt and attentive. The food was good. Not great, but really good. I had the chicken fried steak (minus gravy) and the meat was tender but just needed a bit of salt. My wife said her salad was good and the steak was as well.  The free sundae (for having military ID (thank you)) was small but delicious!  My wife's cheesecake was great!  

We will be here again!

Great food but the service is extremely poor. Management is extremely disorganized. The person that handles people sitting down to their table was rude and appeared to be annoyed that we came to dine in the restaurant. 

Oh calling this place? Good luck because the phone just keep ringing and after a while they place the phone off the hook so it goes straight to a voice mail that isn't set up. 

Management is terrible and it is amazing how they are able to remain in business treating their customers so poorly. 

The food is the ONLY reason why I still come to spend my money here. If another restaurant opens up serving similar foods I would rather try that place out before coming to this sh!t show of a restaurant that appears to a place that people come for the food. 

Food is delicious when you are able to be served and receive your order. 

This establishment needs general training on how to ran a restaurant. 

These issues I explained above have existed since I have been introduced to this place from a friend over 3 years ago.

Mr. Ed's is usually our first stop when we get into town.  One of our favorite places to eat in NOLA.  Great casual, laid back atmosphere with awesome food.  Everything we've had there has been great. Raw oysters are always great here.  For us, other must-try's are: chargrilled oysters, crawfish bread, crawfish etouffee, gumbo and jambalaya.   Everything we've tried here has been great - you really can't go wrong!  Plus, the staff is always  friendly and the service is great.

Post race this morning we stopped in at City Market to warm up and grab some food.  Crepes sounded like the perfect thing.  I ordered the avocado mash crepe, it got made fresh in front of me so fast.  The crepe is so chewy and warm and the avocado with lime and sea salt went so well with the sweet dough.  Price for portions are unbelievable!  My friend ordered the ham and egg crepe and it was massive!  Close to a pound of food for under $9! If you are in city market definitely stop by!

This place was alittle hard to get to because of how the area is laid out. I wasn't familiar with the way the streets flowed. But besides that, there are no tables inside, just fish tank (that my 5 yr old loved). The food wasn't pricy but if you do what I did and got a few things to sample, it can add up. The drunken noodles that i came here for were on the dry side and a bit disappointing and the shrimp penang i ordered mild was too spicy. My husband ordered one of the salmon dishes and loved it. Go figure. Lol. So, i would try them again but if its not a home run the next time I won't be back a third time.
Great place to have some authentic Canton BBQ!!! The greetings are so warm from them.

I've given this location a couple more tries and the drive thru wait is simply too long - 21 minutes today and probably as long last time. Other locations in Franklin can handle as much traffic in half the time. There were also items missing from my order. I wish I could report a better experience, but Chick-fil-A can do better here. This Highway 96 chicken shack needs help!

Nice place.
Good eggs.
Bacon is great.
Grits ,terrific.
Potatos good.
Coffee very good.
Chicken sausage  OK.
Regular sausage patty awful. 
Too salty, and way too much sage.
The only thing that was not even edible.
Nice staff.

Walking around the plaza and found this spot with the family so decided to,stop in. Glad we did. Very open design so you can see the whole kitchen but the downside is it's hard to hear yourself when placing an order especially with masks (I have no issues with wearing masks).  Our order had a few mistakes but they apologized and corrected them right away and comped us for the errors.  The kids and I loved the food.  Got the crispy chicken sandwich and let me tell you I didn't feel lethargic afterwards which tells me it's a fresh product.   The chocolate shake was a little watery. The cheeseburger was really good as well as the fries. We will go back again for sure. Staff was very friendly and the place was clean. It didn't smell like a greasy food pit.
My go to for breakfast. I love going there on Saturday mornings for breakfast and jazz. Great people and food. A true neighborhood gem!

Where's the beef ??? And when I did find it  it wasent seasoned  just  a plain beef patty what a joke !! So many people have been talking about this place so I had to try it .
I had the mushroom burger  4 little slices of mushroom !! 
It took 4 guys 15 minutes to cook 2 burgers  ha ha I couldn't believe it , hey I can wait for a good fresh cooked meal  but really  !! I could have cooked a way better meal at home just add seasoning  to the burger  and MUSHROOMS  !! 
It was over priced and not good !! what a disappointment
The definition of a hole in a wall place. By far, best breakfast burrito I've had. Highly highly recommend.

This place was sooooo good. 

First of all, I am not well versed in Tapas style food. The menu at first seemed intimidating for someone who hasn't eaten a lot of this type of food but our waitress was super helpful and gave us lots of recommendations.

We got the croquetas, coliflor, remolacha, and a few other dishes. All of them were so tasty! I will be back for sure.

Started great with great service but than they skipped my order which is again no big deal but when I asked her if they did skip me knowing they did because I saw them giving my food to a customer who had ordered 10 minutes after us the lady lied and said they don't go by numbers in order or something so I asked kindly for a refund instead of waiting to rush make my order my little girl was acting up and they rush the food to the counter and didn't give me a refund I'm bummed because one of my good Hawaiian friends sent me to taste some authentic Hawaiian I'm not one to post negative on here the food was decent I think I should have picked something different hoping if I try to go back next time service will be better or at least honest

Never been! Will go again!

Cute little place in midtown. Probably used to be a two or three bedroom house back in the day as many midtown businesses are.

Nice rustic/bbq uplifting decor and super nice staff. Prices are up there but it's to be expected for BBQ. Offerings range from port to need to brisket to bowls!! Tater salad is great, Mac n cheese was amazing. Beverage options include tea, soda and a variety of craft beer.

Just six tables and two pub tables although they do have outdoor seating. There is a sign outside that says they do sell out so get there early and enjoy!!!

The fried chicken was the best I've ever had. The skin was crispy with a touch of spice. The meat tender and juicy. The potato salad was tasty. The biscuits were warm, soft and flaky. I cleaned my plate very quickly. Our waitress Judit was pleasant, helpful and attentive. She wanted to make sure our dining experience was positive and it was fabulous. If you are in the New Orleans area this is a must try.

Came here a couple weeks ago just to grab my banh mi fix (takeout only for me). There aren't many Vietnamese restaurants on the north side of Philly outside of Chinatown so this is a plus in the bustling northern liberties neighborhood.

Staff is extra friendly. It's not a huge establishment, the seats were pretty much filled up and I spotted what looked like an extra room for larger parties. Either way after I took my order they had a nice bench to sit whilst my sandwich was being prepared where they alerted me when it was ready. 

The sandwich was pretty good. Bread was perfection. Sometimes the bread on banh mi sandwiches are too hard and hurt the roof of my mouth but not this one. They were not stingy with the toppings and garnishments especially carrots. Almost a little more than needed. There was a huge cucumber slice inside. The meat was nicely cooked, I would say maybe just a TAD bit lacking in flavor but I still thoroughly enjoyed. Price was decent. Would definitely come back here to fulfill my craving.

This place has the best lunch buffet in the city.  All of their food is delicious and fairly unique if your used to Indian food.  My personal favorites are the glass sweat potato noodles, chicken korma, and the mango pudding.  Make sure to check this place out for lunch.  The owner also seems like a great guy that has done a lot for his home country.

I would like to give this place zero stars if that was an option. Our neighbor recommended the place so we figure we try it out with our less than 2 year old toddler. BAD IDEA! Def the worst place I've been to with my girl. Not kid friendly at all. We were told it would be a 30 min wait which ended up being an hour. My toddler was obviously hungry after waiting an hour but still behaving. After we sat down I told the waitress if I could put my appetizer in and was told that she needed the complete order for the kitchen. Ok fine! Whatever! So I asked if she could bring the bread so my little toddler could start eating. She said NO!! That it's one of the house rules to not bring bread without the complete order. Are you serious???? You're going to refuse bread for a hungry toddler??  SHAME ON YOU! The guests next to our table heard her response and gave us their bread after making a comment about how ridiculous her response was. I have never been so upset. I should have just walked out of the restaurant at that point. I don't know why we even stayed. The booster seat they brought for my child had no straps and was flimsy definitely not a good combo with their cheap flimsy chairs. Food was mediocre at best. Derived was so slow. One of the waiter spilled my husbands beer while cleaning the table and didn't offer to bring him another one or apologized for spilling it. WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE!! I am seriously upset with myself for leaving a generous tip. I want my money back! This p

Horrible. From the 30min wait after being seated for the server to take our order  to food.  Upon arriving we had to wait about 5 minutes until the Hostess showed up to her station. We were seated and after 30minutes need to go back to the hostess to request a waitress to take our order. The three of us each ordered a burger. 2 Mediums and a Medium rare. I have no idea why the waitress asked how we wanted it cooked as apparently the "Chef" can only cook very well done burgers (as that's what we each got). The burgers were served with blue flags that said medium. The burger buns were plain, not toasted or anything which made the burger even more gross. We didn't send it back as we had already waited far too long after our order was taken to be served. I also ordered a french onion soup (which came out with the meal, despite asked to have it come out before the meal) The French Onion soup can only be described as foul tasting. Matter of fact an hour after eating there I still have that foul taste in my mouth. A total all around disgusting experience.  Which is a shame as I've eaten at the MaGerk's in Horsham and it was wonderful.   I can honestly say this was one of if not the worst meal I've ever had so far this year.

Wow! Where has this been all my life! My new favorite.fast food chain, hands down.
Green chili burger with.seasoned fries. Be sure a d get a side of Blake's sauce.

Fries were fresh and burgers hot off the grill. Service quick and friendly.

Hope I can come back soon.
I had a good time overall the food was good, atmosphere is good for date nite. I would not go back though
